operative_text:
Section 3 (chapter 33 of NRS): “High-risk individual” means a person who poses a risk of causing personal injury to himself, herself or another person by possessing or having under his or her custody or control, or purchasing or otherwise acquiring, any firearm.
Section 8 (chapter 33 of NRS): The court may issue an emergency order for protection against a high-risk individual if the court finds there is reasonable cause to believe from specific facts shown by a verified application that:
Section 9 (chapter 33 of NRS): Each order for protection against a high-risk individual must include: (a) A requirement that the high-risk individual surrender any firearm in his or her possession or under his or her custody or control in the manner set forth in section 10 of this act; and (b) A prohibition on the high-risk individual against possessing or having under his or her custody or control, or purchasing or otherwise acquiring, any firearm while the order is in effect.
Section 10 (chapter 33 of NRS): The local law enforcement agency shall store any such firearm or may contract with a licensed firearm dealer to provide storage.
Section 10 (chapter 33 of NRS): If there is probable cause to believe that the high-risk individual has not surrendered any firearm in his or her possession or under his or her custody or control immediately after service of the order, the court may issue and deliver to any law enforcement officer a search warrant which authorizes the officer to enter and search any place where there is probable cause to believe any firearm is located and seize the firearm.
Section 10 (chapter 33 of NRS): A local law enforcement agency shall return any surrendered or seized firearm to the high-risk individual not less than 14 days after the order expires.
Section 16 (chapter 33 of NRS): A person who intentionally violates an order for protection against a high-risk individual is: 1. Unless a more severe penalty is prescribed by law for the act that constitutes the violation of the order, guilty of a misdemeanor; and 2. Prohibited from possessing or having under his or her custody or control, or purchasing or otherwise acquiring, a firearm for a period of 5 years.
Section 19 (NRS 202.3657): (h) Is currently subject to an order for protection against a high-risk individual.
